value_text: Contract auto-renews for one additional twelve-month term unless written notice is delivered before the notice deadline.
Renewal or non-renewal notice must be delivered at least 90 days before the current term end date.
Benchmarking rights are present for infrastructure towers, service desk rates, and recurring run labor every twelve months.
Client may terminate for convenience after the second contract year with 120 days notice; transition assistance fees are capped at three months of base run fees.
Monthly service credit equals 2% of the monthly base run fee for each missed SLA period where resolved-within-SLA performance falls below 95%.
Recurring service tasks repeated for three consecutive months must be reviewed for conversion into the fixed run-service catalog at quarterly business review.
Vendor must maintain HIPAA-aligned safeguards, privileged-access logging, ticket audit trails, annual SOC reporting, and incident notification within twenty-four hours.
Client may request supporting delivery, invoice, utilization, SLA, ticket, and change-order records during quarterly business review or invoice dispute process.
